keyboard._comment: velocity: keys/sec over velocity_window seconds. burst: same key >= burst_threshold times in burst_window seconds.

undo_storm._comment: Flags Ctrl-Z spam. undo_count_threshold undos inside window_seconds = someone is NOT okay.

mouse_slam._comment: Flags violent cursor throws. pixel_velocity_threshold is px/sec; consecutive_slams must happen in a row.

crash_detection._comment: Watches for unexpected exits of the listed processes. Add whatever you're likely to rage-kill.

failed_builds._comment: Counts non-zero exits from build/test commands wrapped with `cg run`. Consecutive failures compound.

overlay._comment: HTTP trigger server embedded in the Electron process.
